Complete Your Profile

A few background details let AdaptIM personalize your targets while keeping the main experience beautifully simple.

Why we ask
Height and age are kept in the background. They help Adapt recognize when lower intake controls should be quietly protected. Sex does not create a separate meal plan; it helps Adapt choose the appropriate starting point within the protein range.
After setup, the Complete Profile prompt disappears. Use the small profile icon on the main screen anytime to edit these details.
